findings.title: Auth response-body transport failure becomes a permanent authentication error
findings.trigger: Auth accepts the bearer and sends HTTP 200 headers; the response body connection then breaks.
findings.observed: 401 AUTH_REQUIRED, retryable=false; the account client unnecessarily refreshes once. Source and both preserved runtime bundles reproduce it. Before-header disconnection correctly returns 503 AUTH_UNAVAILABLE.
findings.proposedRepair: Separate Auth body consumption/network handling from JWT-claim parsing. Keep body transport/provider failures retryable 503 and preserve genuine invalid-identity 401 behavior.

findings.title: Classroom retains the 20000-event cap removed from general learning
findings.trigger: The same account has 20001 admitted canonical learning events.
findings.observed: General synk-learning accepts the 20001st event (200); classroom practice and assignment submission both return 409 HISTORY_CAPACITY. Both canonical source and preserved classroom runtime reproduce it; the rejected requests add no events.
findings.proposedRepair: Use bounded canonical validation lookups in classroom append while preserving sharing-revision, run-binding, idempotency and server-score guards; remove the inconsistent capacity fence.

improvements.title: The backend deployment source branch has no automatic test receipt
improvements.implication: The default-branch Talk CI success and the appsscript cross-repository checks do not execute the deployed release branch backend changes.
improvements.proposedRepair: Connect test-only verification to the backend release branch or its PR; keep manual Android build submission separate.

improvements.title: The account summary still replays full history while holding the account row lock
improvements.implication: The removed global history cap permits continuing growth; summary reads still fetch the whole log. No production latency or failure is claimed.
improvements.proposedRepair: Measure long-history summary cost, then consider an exact projection or revision/sequence cache that preserves complete-history exposure and exclusion rules.
